import importlib

# Load the implementation directly from the frozen candidate source tree.

if str(SOURCE_ROOT.parent) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE_ROOT.parent))
hyperbolic = importlib.import_module("TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare.model.hyperbolic")
model_module = importlib.import_module("TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare.model.model")


class GeometryGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_poincare_squared_distance_gradcheck_and_finite_difference(self):
        # Away from the coincident-point square-root singularity and projection boundary.
        x = torch.tensor([[0.12, -0.08], [0.21, 0.07]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.04, 0.09], [0.03, -0.11]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        fn = lambda a, b: hyperbolic.squared_distance(a, b, c=1.0).sum()
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(fn, (x, y), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))

        value = fn(x, y)
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(value, (x, y))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(gx).all().item())
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(gy).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 1e-7)
        self.assertGreater(gy.norm().item(), 1e-7)
        step = 1e-6
        plus = x.detach().clone(); plus[0, 0] += step
        minus = x.detach().clone(); minus[0, 0] -= step
        finite_difference = (fn(plus, y.detach()) - fn(minus, y.detach())) / (2 * step)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(gx[0, 0].item(), finite_difference.item(), delta=2e-5)

    def test_flat_limit_has_expected_nonzero_gradient(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.1]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.05, 0.15]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        loss = hyperbolic.squared_distance(x, y, c=0.0).sum()
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(loss, (x, y))
        expected = 8.0 * (x.detach() - y.detach())
        torch.testing.assert_close(gx, expected)
        torch.testing.assert_close(gy, -expected)
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 0.0)

    def test_projection_keeps_interior_gradient_and_bounds_output(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.1], [1.3, 0.4]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        projected = hyperbolic.project_ball(x, radius=0.9)
        self.assertTrue(torch.all(torch.linalg.vector_norm(projected, dim=-1) <= 0.9 + 1e-12).item())
        projected[0].square().sum().backward()
        self.assertGreater(x.grad[0].norm().item(), 0.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(x.grad).all().item())


class ModelLossGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _small_model(self):
        config = type("Config", (), {
            "hidden_sizes": (8,), "dropout": 0.0, "codebook_num": 3,
            "codebook_size": (4, 4, 4), "codebook_dim": 2,
            "curvature": 1.0, "radius": 0.9,
        })()
        torch.manual_seed(17)
        net = model_module.RQVAE(config, in_dim=3).double()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for level, codes in enumerate(net.rq.codebooks):
                codes.copy_(torch.tensor([[0.10, 0.02], [-0.12, 0.06],
                                          [0.04, -0.15], [0.18, 0.11]], dtype=torch.float64)
                            + level * 0.01)
        embeddings = torch.tensor([[0.3, -0.2, 0.1], [-0.1, 0.4, 0.2],
                                   [0.2, 0.15, -0.3], [-0.25, 0.1, 0.35]], dtype=torch.float64)
        return net, embeddings

    def test_real_model_loss_backpropagates_to_encoder_and_each_codebook(self):
        net, embeddings = self._small_model()
        net.refresh_assignment(embeddings)
        loss, reconstruction, balance = net.loss(embeddings, torch.arange(len(embeddings)))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(torch.stack((loss, reconstruction, balance))).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(loss.item(), 0.0)
        self.assertTrue(reconstruction.requires_grad)
        self.assertTrue(balance.requires_grad)
        loss.backward()

        encoder_grads = [p.grad for p in net.encoder.parameters()]
        self.assertTrue(all(g is not None and torch.isfinite(g).all().item() for g in encoder_grads))
        self.assertGreater(sum(g.norm().item() for g in encoder_grads), 1e-8)
        for level, codebook in enumerate(net.rq.codebooks):
            self.assertIsNotNone(codebook.grad, "codebook level %d is graph-disconnected" % level)
            self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(codebook.grad).all().item())
            self.assertGreater(codebook.grad.norm().item(), 1e-9,
                               "codebook level %d received no useful gradient" % level)

    def test_frozen_assignment_target_does_not_create_gradient_path(self):
        net, embeddings = self._small_model()
        net.refresh_assignment(embeddings)
        self.assertFalse(net.frozen_reconstruction.requires_grad)
        self.assertFalse(net.frozen_codes.requires_grad)
        loss, _, _ = net.loss(embeddings, torch.arange(len(embeddings)))
        loss.backward()
        # This negative control verifies gradients come from current differentiable
        # computations, not through the epoch-frozen assignment/reconstruction target.
        self.assertIsNone(net.frozen_reconstruction.grad)
        self.assertIsNone(net.frozen_codes.grad)

    def test_nonfinite_input_is_not_mistaken_for_valid_gradient(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[float("nan"), 0.1]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[0.0, -0.1]], dtype=torch.float64)
        value = hyperbolic.squared_distance(x, y, c=1.0).sum()
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(value).item())
        grad, = torch.autograd.grad(value, x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(grad).all().item())

    def test_detached_loss_negative_control_is_disconnected(self):
        parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([0.4], dtype=torch.float64))
        disconnected = parameter.detach().square().sum()
        self.assertFalse(disconnected.requires_grad)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            disconnected.backward()
        self.assertIsNone(parameter.grad)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
